values.subject: Hu-Jia chartered vehicle: Round-trip quote for July 21
values.body_text: Two 49-seat coaches for a round trip from Xuhui Headquarters to Jiaxing Nanhu Industrial Park, including expressway tolls and driver meal allowances, for 12,800 yuan; a company-header invoice can be issued. We will report the driver and vehicle information for the day of departure 3 days in advance.
